Name.value: Certificates of compliance with certain environmental protection systems or standards

Description.value: If the contracting authority requires the submission of certificates attesting the compliance of the candidate or tenderer with certain environmental protection systems or standards, it shall specify the Eco-Management and Audit Scheme (EMAS) of the European Union or environmental protection standards through relevant European or international standards. The contracting authority shall also be entitled to invoke other environmental management systems recognised in accordance with Article 45 of Regulation (EC) No 1221/2009 of the European Parliament and the Council of 25 November 2009 on the voluntary participation by organisations in a Community eco-management and audit scheme (EMAS), repealing Regulation (EC) No 761/2001 and Commission Decisions 2001/681/EC and 2006/193/EC (OJ L 342/1 of 22 December 2009) or other environmental management standards based on relevant European or international standards of accredited bodies. Certificates must be issued by independent persons accredited under the relevant series of European standards by the Bulgarian Accreditation Service or by another national accreditation body which is a party to the Multilateral Agreement on Mutual Recognition of the European Accreditation Organisation for the relevant area or meet the requirements for recognition under Article 5 a, Para. 2 of the National Accreditation of Conformity Assessment Bodies Act. The contracting authority shall accept equivalent certificates issued by bodies established in other Member States. The contracting authority shall also accept other evidence of equivalent environmental protection measures where a candidate or tenderer had no access to such certificates or was unable to obtain them within the relevant time limits for reasons beyond their control. In this case, the candidate or tenderer must be able to demonstrate that the proposed measures are equivalent to the required ones. (Art. 64, Para. 4, Para. 5, Para. 6, Para. 7, Para. 8 of Bulgarian Public Procurement Act).
